findings.note: The verifier reads package/SNAPSHOT.json before rejecting a symlink or junction at that path. A crafted package can therefore make verification read outside the package (even though the later walk reports drift). Reject link/reparse-point inventory files before read_bytes and cover this case in a receiving-side test.

TIMESTAMP_RE checks only shape, so impossible dates or offsets (for example month 99 or +99:99) pass receiving-side schema validation. Parse and validate the timestamp as an actual ISO-8601 datetime with offset, and add malformed-value cases; otherwise an invalid inventory can be reported intact when its marker is recomputed.

The contract says source_path is present only for package-doc entries whose package and authoring paths differ, but the schema and receiver enforce only its path syntax/origin. They accept a missing source_path for a differing package-doc path or a redundant equal path. Encode/enforce the relationship or narrow the stated contract.

findings.note: These manual acceptance and closure tasks remain unchecked. Fixture tests do not establish the real destination assembly/refusal cases, receiving-side checkout isolation, consumer install/update walkthroughs, human docs review, boundary sweep, standalone scan, or traceability closure. Keep them open until their own evidence is recorded.

The plan describes zero cloud footprint as confirmed. Per the stated evidence boundary, this is human-accepted scope, not verified isolation; the code and fixture tests provide no isolation proof. Retain the distinction in status/reporting and do not claim verified isolation.
